**Visual analysis of test image:**

- Leaves are tightly **bunched/clustered at the top** of short stems in a rosette-like arrangement

- Overall plant size is much smaller than healthy banana plants

This presentation is textbook **Bunchy Top** disease (caused by Banana Bunchy Top Virus / BBTV). The hallmark is exactly this crowding of leaves at the growing point with stunted internodes, giving the characteristic "bunched" appearance at the top of the plant. No leaf spot patterns, no cigar-end rot on fruit, no wilting from vascular disease — the whole-plant stunting with apical leaf clustering is the key discriminator.
